plan.start: One second after the first joint visual TRACKING state
plan.future_inputs: Latest command held; no future gyro, camera, force or motor command
plan.private_state: Scoring only, after prediction outputs are frozen

model.force_units: Specific force m/s2, not newtons. Axial lag fit holds the prior thrust curve fixed; vertical drag is omitted in that lag diagnostic.
model.timing: Effective lag on the arrival-aligned public clock; physical actuation and IMU publication delays are not separately identified.
model.role: Diagnostic only. This fitted rotational model does not replace live gyro propagation or change controller commands.

scope: Cold airborne takeover, same setup profile and learned map. Four original frozen trials, then a labelled one-metre finish-clearance retest. No repeatability or causal live gap-effect claim; paired estimator ablations isolate missing image factors.
force_lag_note: Validation RMS is within1% of its minimum over0-15ms; this is a shallow effective-lag profile, not a physical-delay confidence interval.
contact_metric: Received in-flight collision packets; zero packets does not establish absence of all physical contact.

paired_estimator_ablations.method: Fixed-command estimator ablation of baseline flight, not closed-loop success evidence. Identical public initialization, commands, IMU, pixels outside the masks and fixed scoring frame.

velocity_discontinuity.interpretation: Abrupt native velocity reversal not represented by the published accelerometer integral. Consistent with an impact/constraint impulse missing from cached IMU data; physical cause unconfirmed. This is a postflight diagnostic, not feedback or a calibrated physical-interval claim.
velocity_discontinuity.private_reference_use: Native attitude rotates force only in this scoring diagnostic. The integral is initialized from one native velocity solely to compare increments.

clip_retention.reason: One small successful clip; all public numeric data and failed-flight scores retained.

response.forecast: At each origin, initialize from the causal public estimator and latest gyro. Hold the latest sent motor commands after the origin. No future commands, gyro, force or camera state enter predictions.
response.scoring: Force against public accelerometer; relative rotation and body rate against private telemetry after prediction freeze. Global state errors are separately scored without test-specific alignment.
response.timing: Effective lag on the arrival-aligned public clock; physical actuation and IMU publication delays are not separately identified.
